title: Cauliflower Wraps
description: Guilt-free mini tortilla-style wraps made from blitzed cauliflower, eggs and garlic. Light and versatile — serve alongside spicy dishes or use as a naan substitute.
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Line two large baking sheets with greaseproof paper.
Blitz the cauliflower florets into crumbs in a blender. Microwave on full power for 2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.
Mix the cauliflower with the eggs and garlic, whisking until smooth and thick.
Dollop 2 dessert spoons per wrap on to baking sheets, at least 10cm apart. Spread into flat circles about 0.5cm thick.
Bake for 10 minutes, flip with a fish slice, bake for another 6 minutes until just colouring.
Sear in a hot buttered frying pan for 2–3 minutes each side before serving.
notes: Makes 8 wraps, serves 4. Swap garlic for curry powder, paprika or za'atar.
